name: Npgsql Database
description: Npgsql Entity Framework database provider for Jellyfin. Database-inclusive full-system restore is unsupported.
overview: Provides a PostgreSQL-backed Jellyfin database through the vanilla custom-provider loader. Keep this plugin active: its small restore guard is required for safe startup.
changelog: Adds qualified LinuxServer and Kubernetes seed images, secure direct Kubernetes Secret passfiles, and hardened release verification.
